whatsappMessage:
Hi Team School of Martial Art India,

I noticed your martial arts academy has fantastic 4.7★ reviews with over 440 happy students in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new class inquiries and trial bookings.

Maine aapke academy ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, self-defense programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/martialindia

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi School of Martial Art India team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke martial arts academy ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for your students in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
